label: Remove Duplicates
description: Remove records whose selected columns all match.

options.label: Keep none
options.description: Remove every record that has a duplicate.

english.default: Identify rows where all values match across these columns: {{#each (duplicateKeys param) separator=", " lastSeparator=", and " pairSeparator=" and "}}{{tableColumn sourceFile sourceAlias fieldName sameSource}}{{else}}{{placeholder "duplicate_columns" "[selected columns]"}}{{/each}}, remove duplicates and {{#switch (default (trim param.duplicate_action) "Keep first record")}}{{#case "Keep first record"}}keep the first record{{/case}}{{#case "Keep last record"}}keep the last record{{/case}}{{#case "Drop all duplicated records"}}keep none of the duplicated records{{/case}}{{#default}}keeping the first record{{/default}}{{/switch}}.

default.excel: =COUNTIFS({{#each (duplicateKeys param legacy=true) separator=", "}}{{#switch (default param.duplicate_action "Keep first record")}}{{#case "Keep last record"}}{{field sourceFile fieldName alias=sourceAlias}}:INDEX({{firstKeyTable (duplicateKeys param legacy=true) param.source_file param.source_alias}}[{{excelColumn (default fieldName (placeholder "field" "[field]"))}}], ROWS({{firstKeyTable (duplicateKeys param legacy=true) param.source_file param.source_alias}}[{{excelColumn (default fieldName (placeholder "field" "[field]"))}}])), {{field sourceFile fieldName alias=sourceAlias}}{{/case}}{{#case "Drop all duplicated records"}}{{firstKeyTable (duplicateKeys param legacy=true) param.source_file param.source_alias}}[{{excelColumn (default fieldName (placeholder "field" "[field]"))}}], {{field sourceFile fieldName alias=sourceAlias}}{{/case}}{{#default}}INDEX({{firstKeyTable (duplicateKeys param legacy=true) param.source_file param.source_alias}}[{{excelColumn (default fieldName (placeholder "field" "[field]"))}}], 1):{{field sourceFile fieldName alias=sourceAlias}}, {{field sourceFile fieldName alias=sourceAlias}}{{/default}}{{/switch}}{{/each}})=1
default.sql: {{#switch (default param.duplicate_action "Keep first record")}}{{#case "Drop all duplicated records"}}COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY {{#each (duplicateKeys param legacy=true) separator=", "}}{{field sourceFile fieldName alias=sourceAlias}}{{/each}}) AS [Duplicate Count] -- keep rows where [Duplicate Count] = 1{{/case}}{{#case "Keep last record"}}ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY {{#each (duplicateKeys param legacy=true) separator=", "}}{{field sourceFile fieldName alias=sourceAlias}}{{/each}} ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS [Duplicate Rank], COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY {{#each (duplicateKeys param legacy=true) separator=", "}}{{field sourceFile fieldName alias=sourceAlias}}{{/each}}) AS [Duplicate Count] -- keep rows where [Duplicate Rank] = [Duplicate Count]{{/case}}{{#default}}ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY {{#each (duplicateKeys param legacy=true) separator=", "}}{{field sourceFile fieldName alias=sourceAlias}}{{/each}} ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS [Duplicate Rank] -- keep rows where [Duplicate Rank] = 1{{/default}}{{/switch}}
default.python: df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=[{{#each (duplicateKeys param legacy=true) separator=", "}}{{quote fieldName}}{{/each}}], keep={{#switch (default param.duplicate_action "Keep first record")}}{{#case "Drop all duplicated records"}}False{{/case}}{{#case "Keep last record"}}"last"{{/case}}{{#default}}"first"{{/default}}{{/switch}})

notes: Note: Keep rows where the Excel formula returns TRUE. First and last follow the current row order.

outcomes.source: Source data contains the duplicate records, and any retained record follows the rule in this step.
